name: I3–I6 — cards, composer intellisense, actions, export
description:
Depends on I1 + I2. Execute as four separate increments in this order, each verified before the next (README §12):

I3 — Cards + preview + focus params
- RichLinkCard.vue + per-kind cards; batched `resolve` endpoint + client LRU cache.
- Focus params: calendar?event=, tasks?task=, git?commit=, harness?run=.
- Acceptance: "show me the task" yields a card that opens the exact task; a 12-link message issues ONE request.

I4 — Composer intellisense
- Provider API + triggers `#` (entities) `/` (commands) `@` (files/people) and ⌘K palette; Monaco completions + hover + ⌘-click; paste-to-link.
- Acceptance: typing `#logi` inserts the right task link; hovering a cxj: URI shows the entity; no network call per keystroke.

I5 — Actions
- `cxj:do/...` buttons, confirm modal, permissions, aiAllowed enforcement (deny-by-default; a profile without permission gets a sentence, not a button).
- Acceptance: a "create task" button works and asks for confirmation.

I6 — Export & other surfaces
- cxjToUrl() compile on copy/email/notifications; wiki + PDF surfaces.
- Acceptance: copying a message yields working absolute URLs.

Security: html:true sanitisation on every non-cxj path; do: actions deny-by-default; no secrets in links.
Files: design/09-rich-links/*, client/src/components/richlinks/*, client/src/components/chat/*
